## Overview

This document composes the main validation figure for the manuscript by combining effect-size scatter plots and sign-concordance analyses for the two reference cohorts, ADNI/AIBL and AddNeuroMed, into a single publication-ready figure.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

# Additional packages (tidyverse, here, janitor, glue loaded via .Rprofile)
pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, ragg, install = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png")
```

```{r}
#| label: load-theme
#| echo: false

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Load Plot Objects

Load pre-generated plot objects from individual validation analyses for composition.

```{r}
#| label: load-plots

# Row 1: AGES vs ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis scatter
fig_adni_aibl_scatter <- read_rds(
  here("validation/output/fig_validation_ADNI_AIBL_scatter_three_transitions_p4.5_p4.0.rds")
)

# Row 2: AGES vs AddNeuroMed scatter
fig_addneuromed_scatter <- read_rds(
  here("validation/output/fig_validation_AddNeuroMed_scatter_two_key.rds")
)

# Row 3: Sign concordance for each reference cohort
fig_directionality_adni_aibl <- read_rds(
  here("validation/output/fig_directionality_ADNI_AIBL_only.rds")
)

fig_addneuromed_bar <- read_rds(
  here("validation/output/fig_directionality_barplot_AddNeuroMed.rds")
)
```

## Modify Plots for Composition

Apply consistent styling and adjust annotations for the composite figure layout.

```{r}
#| label: helper-adjust-annotations

# Helper function to adjust y position of p-value annotations in scatter plots
# The original plots have r at y=I(0.95) and p at y=I(0.90), which overlap
# This shifts the p-value annotation down for better spacing
adjust_pval_annotation_y <- function(plot, new_y = 0.80) {
  for (i in seq_along(plot$layers)) {
    layer <- plot$layers[[i]]
    # Check if this is a geom_text layer
    if (inherits(layer$geom, "GeomText") && !is.null(layer$aes_params$y)) {
      y_val <- layer$aes_params$y
      # Handle I() wrapped values (AsIs class)
      if (inherits(y_val, "AsIs")) {
        y_val <- as.numeric(y_val)
      }
      # Check if y is around 0.90 (p-value position)
      if (isTRUE(all.equal(y_val, 0.90, tolerance = 0.02))) {
        plot$layers[[i]]$aes_params$y <- I(new_y)
      }
    }
  }
  plot
}

# Helper function to reduce font sizes in facet strip labels for main figure
# The pval_cutoff is a factor - need to modify data in main plot AND all layers
boost_text_annotation_size <- function(plot, factor = 1.4) {
  for (i in seq_along(plot$layers)) {
    geom <- plot$layers[[i]]$geom
    if (inherits(geom, "GeomText") || inherits(geom, "GeomLabel")) {
      ap <- plot$layers[[i]]$aes_params
      if (!is.null(ap$size)) {
        plot$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size <- ap$size * factor
      }
    }
  }
  plot
}

reduce_strip_font_sizes <- function(plot, main_size = "7pt", sub_size = "5pt",
                                     old_main_size = "12pt", old_sub_size = "9pt") {
  # Helper to modify a single data frame
  modify_pval_cutoff <- function(df) {
    if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df)) return(df)
    if (!"pval_cutoff" %in% names(df)) return(df)

    new_values <- df$pval_cutoff |>
      as.character() |>
      str_replace(paste0("font-size:", old_sub_size), paste0("font-size:", sub_size))
    df$pval_cutoff <- factor(new_values, levels = unique(new_values))
    df
  }

  # Modify main plot data
  plot$data <- modify_pval_cutoff(plot$data)

  # Modify data in each layer (some layers have their own data frames)
  for (i in seq_along(plot$layers)) {
    layer_data <- plot$layers[[i]]$data
    if (!is.null(layer_data) && is.data.frame(layer_data)) {
      plot$layers[[i]]$data <- modify_pval_cutoff(layer_data)
    }
  }

  plot
}
```

```{r}
#| label: helper-label-shortener

# Helper function to shorten labels in plots
shorten_labels <- function(text) {
  text |>
    str_replace("Correlation", "Corr") |>
    str_replace("Association", "Asso") |>
    str_replace("ADNI/AIBL Meta-analysis", "ADNI/AIBL Meta") |>
    str_replace("CSF ", "") |>
    str_replace("CSF", "")
}

# Helper to modify strip labels (facet titles)
shorten_strip_labeller <- function(labels) {
  lapply(labels, shorten_labels)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: modify-plots

# Common theme modifications
# For Nature Genetics: full page width ~180mm (~7 inches)
# Font sizes: minimum 5pt, preferred 6-8pt for labels
base_size <- 7

# Helper to modify strip text in existing plots
modify_strip_labels <- function(plot) {
  # Modify the facet params labeller
  plot$facet$params$labeller <- as_labeller(shorten_labels)
  plot
}

# Panels A and b span the full text width, so their annotations can carry a larger
# boost than the half-width panels of the previous six-panel layout.
scatter_boost <- 1.7

# Row 1 (a): AGES vs ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis scatter
fig_a <- fig_adni_aibl_scatter |>
  reduce_strip_font_sizes(sub_size = "5pt", old_sub_size = "6.5pt") |>
  adjust_pval_annotation_y(new_y = 0.82) |>
  modify_strip_labels()

# Axis titles name each study's own effect measure (reviewer R2.7) and give the
# number of participants as "n" (R1.7)
fig_a <- fig_a +
  labs(
    x = "AGES effect size <br> <span style='font-size:5pt'>(n = 2,491)</span>",
    y = "ADNI/AIBL log<sub>2</sub> OR per 0.01 beta <br> <span style='font-size:5pt'>(n = 797)</span>"
  ) +
  theme_main_fig(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = base_size),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.9),
    legend.text = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.8)
  )
fig_a <- rescale_layer_params(fig_a, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
fig_a <- boost_text_annotation_size(fig_a, factor = scatter_boost)

# Row 2 (b): AGES vs AddNeuroMed scatter
fig_b <- fig_addneuromed_scatter |>
  adjust_pval_annotation_y(new_y = 0.82) |>
  modify_strip_labels()

fig_b <- fig_b +
  labs(
    x = "AGES effect size <br> <span style='font-size:5pt'>(n = 2,491)</span>",
    y = "AddNeuroMed difference in adjusted beta <br> <span style='font-size:5pt'>(n = 284)</span>"
  ) +
  theme_main_fig(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = base_size),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.9),
    legend.text = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.8)
  )
fig_b <- rescale_layer_params(fig_b, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
fig_b <- boost_text_annotation_size(fig_b, factor = scatter_boost)

# Row 3 left (c): ADNI/AIBL sign concordance. The single facet's lines rise toward the
# relaxed thresholds on the right, so the legend sits in the empty upper left.
fig_c <- fig_directionality_adni_aibl |>
  modify_strip_labels()

fig_c <- fig_c +
  # P in the house style (custom_func/p_value_label.R): -log10 P with an italic P. The space
  # after the subscript is a four-per-em space (U+2005): ggtext drops an ordinary or a non-breaking
  # space there
  labs(
    x = "−log<sub>10</sub>\u2005*P* threshold (meta-analysis)",
    y = "−log<sub>10</sub>\u2005*P* (binomial test)",
    color = "AGES"
  ) +
  theme_main_fig(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = base_size),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    strip.text = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    legend.position = c(0.26, 0.78),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.95), color = NA),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.9),
    legend.text = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.8),
    legend.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
  )
fig_c <- rescale_layer_params(fig_c, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)

# Row 3 right (d): AddNeuroMed sign concordance barplot (keep legend inside plot)
fig_d <- fig_addneuromed_bar +
  labs(x = "AGES cohort", y = "−log<sub>10</sub>\u2005*P* (binomial test)") +
  theme_main_fig(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = base_size),
    axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = base_size),
    legend.position = c(0.22, 0.85),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.95), color = NA),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.9),
    legend.text = element_markdown(size = base_size * 0.8),
    legend.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
  )
fig_d <- rescale_layer_params(fig_d, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5)
```

## Compose Figure

Arrange the four panels with patchwork: the two scatter grids each span the full text width, and the two sign-concordance panels share the bottom row. Panel letters follow the order the panels Are added, not the layout string.

```{r}
#| label: compose-figure

# Define layout: two full-width rows, then a half-and-half row
layout <- "
AAAA
BBBB
CCDD
"

fig_validation <- fig_a + fig_b + free(fig_c, side = "r") + fig_d +
  plot_layout(
    design = layout,
    heights = c(2.6, 2.6, 2.2)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
```

## Save Figure

Export the composite figure as a high-resolution PNG for manuscript inclusion.

```{r}
#| label: save-figure

fs::dir_create(here("validation/patch_figures/output"))

agg_png(
  here("validation/patch_figures/output/fig_validation.png"),
  width = 6.5, height = 8, units = "in", res = 600
)
print(fig_validation)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| label: display-figure
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12

fig_validation
```
